name: Family & Kinship Roles
description: Roles defined by marriage, descent, adoption, and other family relationships.

name: Spouse
description: A married person considered in relation to their marital partner.

name: Husband
description: A man in a marital relationship.

name: Wife
description: A woman in a marital relationship.

name: Widow
description: A woman whose spouse has died and who has not remarried.

name: Widower
description: A man whose spouse has died and who has not remarried.

name: Uxorilocal Husband
description: A husband who resides with and joins his wife's family line, as in Chinese ruzhui marriage.

name: Parent
description: A person who raises or begets a child and bears parental responsibility.

name: Father
description: A male parent.

name: Mother
description: A female parent.

name: Stepfather
description: The husband of one's parent who is not one's biological or adoptive father.

name: Stepmother
description: The wife of one's parent who is not one's biological or adoptive mother.

name: Adoptive Parent
description: A parent who legally adopts a child not biologically their own.

name: Foster Parent
description: An adult who temporarily cares for a child placed by an agency or kin network.

name: Guardian
description: A person with legal authority and duty to care for a minor or dependent.

name: Grandparent
description: A parent of one's parent.

name: Grandfather
description: The father of one's parent.

name: Grandmother
description: The mother of one's parent.

name: Child (Kinship)
description: A son or daughter considered in relation to their parents.

name: Son
description: A male child in relation to his parents.

name: Daughter
description: A female child in relation to her parents.

name: Adopted Child
description: A child legally raised by parents who are not their biological parents.

name: Child Bride
description: A girl married before adulthood, historically practiced in many societies.

name: Sibling
description: A brother or sister sharing one or both parents.

name: Brother
description: A male sibling.

name: Sister
description: A female sibling.

name: Extended Kin
description: Relatives beyond the nuclear family, linked by blood or marriage.

name: Aunt
description: The sister of one's parent or the wife of one's uncle.

name: Uncle
description: The brother of one's parent or the husband of one's aunt.

name: Cousin
description: The child of one's aunt or uncle.

name: Nephew
description: The son of one's sibling.

name: Niece
description: The daughter of one's sibling.

name: In-Law
description: A relative acquired through marriage rather than blood.

name: Mother-in-Law
description: The mother of one's spouse.

name: Father-in-Law
description: The father of one's spouse.

name: Son-in-Law
description: The husband of one's daughter.

name: Daughter-in-Law
description: The wife of one's son.

name: Co-Sibling-in-Law
description: The spouse of one's spouse's sibling, as in Chinese zhouli or lianjin.

name: Lineage & Ancestry Roles
description: Roles defined by descent, ancestry, and inheritance within a family line.

name: Matriarch
description: A woman who heads and holds authority over a family or lineage.

name: Patriarch
description: A man who heads and holds authority over a family or lineage.

name: Ancestor
description: A forebear from whom a family line descends, often venerated.

name: Descendant
description: A person who descends from a particular ancestor.

name: Heir
description: A person entitled to inherit a family's property, title, or position.

name: Family Elder
description: A senior family member whose age confers respect and advisory authority.

name: Fictive Kinship Roles
description: Chosen kin relations modeled on family bonds without blood or marriage ties.

name: Godparent
description: A sponsor of a child's religious initiation who assumes a mentoring kinship role.

name: Compadre
description: A co-parent bound by godparenthood, a central kinship bond in Latin America.

name: Blood Brother
description: A non-kin male bound by a sworn oath or blood ritual of brotherhood.

name: Wet Nurse
description: A woman who breastfeeds and nurtures another woman's child, often as a long-term bond.

name: Milk Sibling
description: An unrelated person who shared the same wet nurse, creating a recognized kin-like bond.

name: Community & Civil Roles
description: Roles people occupy in neighborhoods, voluntary associations, and civil society.

name: Community Membership Roles
description: Roles defined by a person's standing or belonging within a locality.

name: Resident
description: A person who lives in a particular place.

name: Newcomer
description: A person newly arrived in a community.

name: Local
description: A long-established member of a place, contrasted with outsiders.

name: Migrant
description: A person who moves within or across regions to live and work.

name: Refugee
description: A person forced to flee their country by war, persecution, or disaster.

name: Exile
description: A person barred from their homeland, usually for political reasons.

name: Neighbor
description: A person living near another, with mutual local obligations.

name: Host
description: A person who receives and provides for guests.

name: Guest
description: A person received and entertained in another's home or community.

name: Community Leadership Roles
description: Roles involving guiding, representing, or organizing a local community.

name: Community Leader
description: A person recognized as a guide and representative of a community.

name: Community Elder
description: A senior member whose experience gives them advisory standing.

name: Community Organizer
description: A person who mobilizes residents around shared goals and collective action.

name: Block Captain
description: A volunteer who represents and coordinates a city block or building.

name: Neighborhood Committee Member
description: An elected or appointed member of a residents' committee governing a district.

name: Volunteer & Advocacy Roles
description: Roles involving unpaid service, giving, and public advocacy.

name: Volunteer
description: A person who gives time and labor to a cause without pay.

name: Philanthropist
description: A person who donates wealth and resources to promote human welfare.

name: Patron
description: A supporter who funds and champions a person, cause, or institution.

name: Activist
description: A person who campaigns to bring about social or political change.

name: Advocate
description: A person who publicly supports and argues for a cause or group.

name: Whistleblower
description: A person who exposes wrongdoing within an organization to the public.

name: Donor
description: A person who gives money, blood, organs, or goods to help others.

name: Dispute Resolution Roles
description: Roles involving settling conflicts and restoring harmony within a community.

name: Mediator
description: A neutral person who helps disputing parties reach an agreement.

name: Peacemaker
description: A person who works to end conflict and reconcile opposing parties.

name: Political & Civic Roles
description: Roles in governance, rule, representation, and the political life of a state.

name: Citizen & Elector Roles
description: Roles tied to membership and participation in a political community.

name: Citizen
description: A legally recognized member of a state with rights and duties.

name: Voter
description: A person who casts a ballot in an election or referendum.

name: Constituent
description: A citizen represented by an elected official.

name: Monarch & Dynastic Roles
description: Hereditary ruling roles of kings, queens, and imperial dynasties.

name: Monarch
description: A hereditary sovereign ruler such as a king or queen.

name: Emperor
description: The sovereign of an empire, ranking above a king.

name: Empress
description: A female sovereign of an empire or the wife of an emperor.

name: King
description: A male monarch ruling a kingdom.

name: Queen
description: A female monarch or the wife of a king.

name: Prince
description: A male member of a royal family or ruler of a principality.

name: Princess
description: A female member of a royal family.

name: Regent
description: A person who governs during a monarch's minority or incapacity.

name: Heir Apparent
description: The person first in line to inherit a throne.

name: Nobility & Aristocracy
description: Hereditary or titled ranks of a privileged ruling class.

name: Noble
description: A member of a hereditary privileged social class.

name: Duke
description: A nobleman of the highest rank below the monarch.

name: Count
description: A European nobleman ranking below a duke.

name: Baron
description: A nobleman of the lowest hereditary rank.

name: Knight
description: A person granted a non-hereditary title for service, historically a mounted warrior.

name: Peer
description: A holder of a title conferring membership in a hereditary or appointed upper house.

name: Executive & Administrative Roles
description: Roles that head or administer the government of a state.

name: Head of State
description: The chief public representative of a state, ceremonial or executive.

name: Head of Government
description: The chief executive officer who leads a government's administration.

name: President
description: An elected or appointed head of state or republic.

name: Prime Minister
description: The head of government in a parliamentary system.

name: Governor
description: The elected or appointed head of a province, state, or territory.

name: Mayor
description: The elected head of a city or municipal government.

name: Minister
description: A senior government member heading a ministry or department.

name: Civil Servant
description: A career employee of the state's administrative bureaucracy.

name: Legislative Roles
description: Roles involving lawmaking and representation in an assembly.

name: Legislator
description: A member of a body that makes laws.

name: Senator
description: A member of a senate or upper legislative chamber.

name: Member of Parliament
description: An elected representative in a parliamentary legislature.

name: Councilor
description: An elected member of a local or municipal council.

name: Speaker
description: The presiding officer of a legislative assembly.

name: Party Whip
description: A legislator who enforces party discipline and manages voting.

name: Tribune
description: An elected plebeian magistrate in ancient Rome empowered to protect citizens.

name: Diplomatic Roles
description: Roles representing a state in relations with other states.

name: Diplomat
description: An official who conducts a state's foreign relations.

name: Ambassador
description: The highest-ranking envoy representing a state in another country.

name: Envoy
description: A diplomatic representative sent on a specific mission.

name: Consul
description: An official protecting a state's citizens and commercial interests abroad.

name: Party & Movement Roles
description: Roles within political parties and social movements.

name: Party Leader
description: The head of a political party.

name: Opposition Leader
description: The leader of the largest party not in government.

name: Party Member
description: A dues-paying member of a political party.

name: Candidate
description: A person standing for election to public office.

name: Non-Western & Historical Rulership
description: Sovereign and high-official roles of non-Western and past polities.
name_zh: 非西方与历史统治角色

name: Sultan
description: A Muslim sovereign ruler, especially of an Ottoman or Malay state.

name: Caliph
description: The successor ruler of the early Muslim community and a politico-religious sovereign.

name: Emir
description: A Muslim prince, commander, or ruler of an emirate.

name: Khan
description: A Mongol or Turkic sovereign or chief.

name: Pharaoh
description: The divine king of ancient Egypt.

name: Maharaja
description: A great king or high-ranking Hindu or Sikh prince in South Asia.

name: Shogun
description: The hereditary military dictator who ruled Japan on the emperor's behalf.

name: Daimyo
description: A feudal territorial lord in pre-modern Japan.

name: Vizier
description: A high-ranking minister or chief advisor in Muslim and Ottoman courts.

name: Mandarin
description: A scholar-official of imperial China appointed through the examination system.

name: Tsar
description: The emperor of Russia or a Slavic imperial sovereign.

name: Legal & Judicial Roles
description: Roles in courts, legal advocacy, adjudication, and the justice system.

name: Judicial Roles
description: Roles that adjudicate disputes and interpret law.

name: Judge
description: An official who presides over a court and decides cases.

name: Justice
description: A judge of a supreme or high court.

name: Chief Justice
description: The presiding judge of a supreme court.

name: Judicial Magistrate
description: A lower-court judge handling minor criminal and civil matters.

name: Lay Judge
description: A citizen who sits alongside professional judges to decide cases.

name: Qadi
description: A judge who applies Islamic law in a sharia court.

name: Legal Advocacy Roles
description: Roles representing parties' interests in legal proceedings.

name: Lawyer
description: A person licensed to advise on and represent clients in legal matters.

name: Barrister
description: A lawyer who pleads cases in higher courts, especially in common-law systems.

name: Solicitor
description: A lawyer who advises clients and prepares cases, traditionally without higher-court advocacy.

name: Prosecutor
description: A lawyer who brings criminal charges on behalf of the state.

name: Public Defender
description: A state-appointed lawyer representing defendants who cannot afford counsel.

name: Jury Roles
description: Roles of lay citizens who decide facts in a trial.

name: Juror
description: A citizen sworn to render a verdict in a trial.

name: Jury Foreperson
description: The juror who presides over deliberations and announces the verdict.

name: Grand Juror
description: A juror on a panel that decides whether to issue indictments.

name: Court & Registry Officials
description: Roles that administer courts and authenticate legal documents.

name: Bailiff
description: A court officer who keeps order and carries out the court's commands.

name: Court Clerk
description: An official who keeps court records and administers proceedings.

name: Notary
description: An official who witnesses and authenticates legal documents and signatures.

name: Registrar
description: An official who maintains civil records of births, marriages, and deaths.

name: Coroner
description: An official who investigates deaths and determines their cause.

name: Litigant & Witness Roles
description: Roles of parties and evidence-givers in legal proceedings.
name_zh: 诉讼当事人与证人角色

name: Plaintiff
description: The party who brings a civil lawsuit.

name: Defendant
description: The party accused or sued in a legal proceeding.

name: Witness
description: A person who gives evidence about facts in a case.

name: Expert Witness
description: A specialist who provides technical or scientific testimony.

name: Alternative Dispute Resolution Roles
description: Roles that resolve disputes outside formal court litigation.

name: Arbitrator (Legal)
description: A neutral person empowered to resolve a dispute by binding decision.

name: Mediator (Legal)
description: A neutral facilitator who helps parties negotiate a voluntary settlement.

name: Religious & Spiritual Roles
description: Roles in organized religion, monastic life, and indigenous spiritual practice.

name: Clergy
description: Ordained officials who lead worship and administer sacraments.

name: Priest
description: An ordained minister authorized to perform sacred rites.

name: Pastor
description: A clergyperson who shepherds and preaches to a congregation.

name: Chaplain
description: A clergyperson serving a secular institution such as a hospital, prison, or army.

name: Bishop
description: A senior clergyperson who oversees a diocese.

name: Archbishop
description: A bishop of the highest rank who leads an ecclesiastical province.

name: Cardinal
description: A high Catholic prelate who elects the pope.

name: Pope
description: The bishop of Rome and supreme head of the Roman Catholic Church.

name: Deacon
description: An ordained minister ranking below a priest.

name: Church Patriarch
description: A leading bishop in Eastern Orthodox and Oriental churches.

name: Monastic & Ascetic Roles
description: Roles of those who withdraw from secular life for spiritual discipline.

name: Monk
description: A man who lives under religious vows in a monastery.

name: Nun
description: A woman who lives under religious vows in a convent.

name: Friar
description: A mendicant monk of an order that serves the wider community.

name: Abbot
description: The head of a monastery.

name: Novice
description: A person in a probationary period before taking religious vows.

name: Hermit
description: A person who lives in solitude for religious devotion.

name: Bhikkhu
description: A fully ordained Buddhist monk in the Theravada tradition.

name: Bhikkhuni
description: A fully ordained Buddhist nun in the Theravada tradition.

name: Lama
description: A Tibetan Buddhist teacher or senior monk.

name: Swami
description: A Hindu ascetic or religious teacher who has renounced worldly life.

name: Sadhu
description: A wandering Hindu holy person devoted to spiritual practice.

name: Fakir
description: A Muslim or Hindu ascetic who lives on alms, often a wandering mystic.

name: Islamic Religious Roles
description: Religious offices and leadership roles within Islam.

name: Imam
description: A Muslim who leads congregational prayer and often guides a community.

name: Mufti
description: A Muslim jurist qualified to issue legal opinions (fatwas).

name: Ayatollah
description: A high-ranking Shi'a religious authority and jurist.

name: Sheikh
description: A respected Muslim elder, scholar, or spiritual leader.

name: Muezzin
description: The person who calls Muslims to prayer from a mosque.

name: Hafiz
description: A Muslim who has memorized the entire Quran.

name: Dervish
description: A member of a Sufi order practicing poverty and mystical devotion.

name: Pir
description: A Sufi spiritual master and guide.

name: Jewish Religious Roles
description: Religious offices and ritual roles within Judaism.

name: Rabbi
description: A Jewish scholar and teacher qualified to decide religious law.

name: Hazzan
description: A synagogue cantor who leads liturgical chanting.

name: Mohel
description: A person trained to perform the Jewish ritual of circumcision.

name: Kohen
description: A Jew of priestly descent who performs certain synagogue blessings.

name: Rebbe
description: The spiritual leader of a Hasidic dynasty.

name: Sofer
description: A scribe who writes Torah scrolls and sacred texts.

name: East & South Asian Religious Roles
description: Spiritual teachers and ritual specialists of Hindu, Buddhist, and Taoist traditions.

name: Guru
description: A Hindu, Sikh, or spiritual teacher who transmits knowledge to disciples.

name: Yogi
description: A practitioner of yoga who has attained spiritual mastery.

name: Sannyasi
description: A Hindu who has renounced worldly life in the final stage of life.

name: Rōshi
description: A venerated Zen Buddhist master and teacher.

name: Daoshi
description: An ordained Taoist priest who performs rituals and liturgy.

name: Fangshi
description: A ritual master and diviner in Chinese folk and Taoist practice.

name: Rinpoche
description: An honored reincarnate lama in Tibetan Buddhism.

name: Tulku
description: A recognized reincarnation of a previous Buddhist master.

name: Indigenous & Folk Religious Roles
description: Spiritual specialists of indigenous, folk, and animist traditions.
name_zh: 原住民与民间宗教角色

name: Shaman
description: A practitioner who enters altered states to mediate with the spirit world.

name: Medicine Person
description: An indigenous healer who uses ritual, plants, and spiritual knowledge.

name: Curandero
description: A Latin American folk healer combining Catholic and indigenous practice.

name: Babalawo
description: A Yoruba Ifá divination priest.

name: Sangoma
description: A southern African diviner and healer who communicates with ancestors.

name: Diviner
description: A specialist who foretells events and reads omens through ritual methods.

name: Spirit Medium
description: A person who is possessed by spirits to convey messages to the living.

name: Druid
description: A priest and learned class of the ancient Celtic peoples.

name: Houngan
description: A male Vodou priest in Haiti.

name: Mambo
description: A female Vodou priestess in Haiti.

name: Lay Religious Roles
description: Non-ordained roles of service and leadership within religious communities.

name: Layperson
description: A non-ordained member of a religious community.

name: Altar Server
description: A lay person, often a youth, who assists the clergy during services.

name: Lector
description: A lay person who reads scripture aloud during worship.

name: Catechist
description: A lay teacher of religious doctrine to converts and children.

name: Missionary
description: A person sent to spread a religion and serve in another community.

name: Evangelist
description: A person who preaches the gospel to convert others.

name: Preacher
description: A person who delivers sermons, often without formal ordination.

name: Ceremonial & Ritual Roles
description: Roles in weddings, funerals, festivals, and other rites of passage.

name: Officiant Roles
description: Roles that lead or preside over ceremonies.

name: Celebrant
description: A person who performs a rite, especially a marriage or memorial.

name: Master of Ceremonies
description: A host who introduces and guides the events of a ceremony or banquet.

name: Wedding Party Roles
description: Supporting roles in a wedding ceremony and celebration.

name: Best Man
description: The groom's principal male attendant and witness.

name: Maid of Honor
description: The bride's principal female attendant.

name: Bridesmaid
description: A female attendant who supports the bride.

name: Groomsman
description: A male attendant who supports the groom.

name: Flower Girl
description: A young girl who scatters petals before the bride.

name: Matchmaker
description: A person who arranges introductions and marriages between families.

name: Nakodo
description: A Japanese go-between who arranges marriages and mediates between families.

name: Funeral & Mourning Roles
description: Roles in death rites and the expression of mourning.

name: Pallbearer
description: A person who carries or escorts a coffin at a funeral.

name: Eulogist
description: A person who delivers a speech praising the deceased.

name: Mourner
description: A person who grieves and participates in funeral rites.

name: Chief Mourner
description: The principal relative who leads mourning and funeral duties.

name: Festival & Pageant Roles
description: Roles in seasonal festivals, carnivals, and public pageants.

name: Carnival King
description: A figurehead who presides over a carnival celebration.

name: Festival Queen
description: A young woman crowned to preside over a local festival.

name: Masquerader
description: A performer who wears a mask and costume in carnival or masquerade.

name: Gender Roles
description: Social roles assigned to or associated with gender identities.

name: Binary Gender Roles
description: Roles tied to the traditional male/female gender binary.

name: Man
description: The adult male gender role in a society.

name: Woman
description: The adult female gender role in a society.

name: Bachelor
description: An unmarried man, especially one past the usual marrying age.

name: Spinster
description: An unmarried woman past the usual marrying age, historically stigmatized.

name: Housewife
description: A woman whose primary role is managing a household and family.

name: Househusband
description: A man whose primary role is managing a household and family.

name: Third-Gender & Gender-Variant Roles
description: Culturally recognized roles beyond the male/female binary.
name_zh: 第三性与性别多元角色

name: Hijra
description: A South Asian third-gender community with its own social and ritual roles.

name: Two-Spirit
description: An Indigenous North American person embodying both masculine and feminine roles.

name: Fa'afafine
description: A Samoan person assigned male at birth who lives a feminine social role.

name: Kathoey
description: A Thai transgender or third-gender woman.

name: Muxe
description: A Zapotec person assigned male at birth who occupies a distinct third-gender role.

name: Sworn Virgin
description: An Albanian woman who takes a vow of chastity and lives as a man.

name: Wakashu
description: A pre-adult male in Edo-period Japan occupying a distinct aesthetic-gender role.

name: Age-Graded & Life-Stage Roles
description: Roles defined by a person's age or stage in the life course.

name: Childhood & Youth Roles
description: Age roles of infancy through youth.

name: Infant
description: A child in the first year of life.

name: Toddler
description: A young child learning to walk, roughly one to three years old.

name: Child (Age)
description: A person between infancy and adolescence.

name: Adolescent
description: A person in the transitional stage between childhood and adulthood.

name: Youth
description: A young person, especially one in the transition to adult roles.

name: Adult & Senior Roles
description: Age roles from adulthood through old age.

name: Young Adult
description: A person in early adulthood, roughly twenties to thirties.

name: Adult
description: A person who has reached the age of majority.

name: Senior Citizen
description: An older person, typically past retirement age.

name: Elder
description: An older person whose age confers respect and advisory status.

name: Retiree
description: A person who has withdrawn from paid work.

name: Coming-of-Age Roles
description: Roles marking the transition to adult status through ritual.

name: Initiate
description: A person undergoing a rite of passage into a new status.

name: Debutante
description: A young woman formally introduced to adult society.

name: Quinceañera
description: A Latin American girl celebrating her fifteenth-birthday coming of age.

name: Seijin-shiki Adult
description: A Japanese young person recognized as an adult at the coming-of-age ceremony.

name: Life-Transition Roles
description: Roles defined by major transitions in the life course.

name: Newlywed
description: A person recently married.

name: Expectant Parent
description: A person expecting the birth of a child.

name: Empty Nester
description: A parent whose children have grown and left home.

name: Clan & Village Roles
description: Roles of leadership and specialists within clans, villages, and tribes.

name: Clan Leadership Roles
description: Roles governing descent groups and clans.

name: Clan Chief
description: The hereditary or elected head of a clan.

name: Lineage Head
description: The head of a lineage segment, often keeper of ancestral rites.

name: Clan Mother
description: A Haudenosaunee woman who selects chiefs and holds clan authority.

name: Ancestral Shrine Keeper
description: A person who maintains an ancestral shrine and performs rites.

name: Village Leadership Roles
description: Roles governing and representing a village community.

name: Village Head
description: The chief or headman of a village.

name: Village Headwoman
description: A female head of a village.

name: Council of Elders Member
description: A member of a body of elders who govern a community.

name: Bao Head
description: The head of a bao, a grassroots mutual-responsibility unit in imperial China.

name: Lizheng
description: A village head in the traditional Chinese administrative system.

name: Market Head
description: A woman who heads a market and its traders, as the Yoruba iyaloja.

name: Tribal Chieftaincy Roles
description: Sovereign and chiefly roles of tribal societies worldwide.

name: Tribal Chief
description: The leader of a tribe or band.

name: Paramount Chief
description: A chief who ranks above other chiefs, ruling a larger polity.

name: Big Man
description: A Melanesian leader who builds influence through gift-giving and reciprocity.

name: Sachem
description: A chief or leader among Algonquian and Iroquoian peoples.

name: Ariki
description: A hereditary Polynesian chief of high rank.

name: Rangatira
description: A Māori hereditary chief and leader of a hapū or iwi.

name: Matai
description: A Samoan family chief who holds a title and governs family land.

name: Oba
description: A Yoruba king who rules a town or kingdom.

name: Kgosi
description: A Tswana hereditary chief.

name: Asantehene
description: The paramount king of the Asante people of Ghana.

name: Queen Mother (Akan)
description: A senior Akan royal woman who counsels the chief and nominates successors.

name: Clan & Village Specialist Roles
description: Specialist roles serving clan and village governance and memory.

name: Griot
description: A West African hereditary oral historian, praise-singer, and advisor.

name: Okyeame
description: An Akan royal spokesperson and linguist who relays the chief's words.

name: Town Crier
description: A person who makes public proclamations in a town or village.

name: Village Mediator
description: A respected villager who settles disputes by customary means.

name: Informal & Honorific Roles
description: Non-institutional roles of mentorship, status, and respectful address.

name: Mentorship Roles
description: Roles of guidance, teaching, and sponsorship between individuals.

name: Mentor
description: An experienced person who guides a less experienced one.

name: Mentee
description: A person guided and supported by a mentor.

name: Role Model
description: A person whose behavior others admire and imitate.

name: Senpai
description: A senior peer who mentors juniors in Japanese organizations.

name: Kōhai
description: A junior peer who defers to a senpai in Japanese organizations.

name: Ustad
description: A master teacher of music or craft in South Asian tradition.

name: Informal Social Position Roles
description: Roles describing a person's informal standing within a group.

name: Leader
description: A person who guides and influences a group by choice or recognition.

name: Follower
description: A person who supports and defers to a leader.

name: Insider
description: A member who belongs to and is accepted by a group.

name: Outsider
description: A person who is not part of or accepted by a group.

name: Intermediary
description: A person who acts between two parties to facilitate an exchange.

name: Social Broker
description: A person who uses connections to link people and resources for benefit.

name: Opinion Leader
description: A person whose views shape the attitudes of others.

name: Influencer
description: A person who shapes audience behavior, especially through social media.

name: Status & Renown Roles
description: Roles of recognized distinction, fame, or eminence.

name: Socialite
description: A person prominent in fashionable high society.

name: Celebrity
description: A widely known and publicized person.

name: Icon
description: A person regarded as a symbolic representative of a culture or cause.

name: Folk Hero
description: A person celebrated in popular tradition for embodying communal values.

name: Elder Statesman
description: A retired senior leader whose counsel is respected.

name: Emeritus
description: A retired holder of a title or office who retains an honorary status.

name: Local Notable
description: A locally prominent and respected person of influence.

name: Honorific & Titular Roles
description: Titles and forms of respectful address marking social distinction.

name: Sir
description: A man holding a knighthood or baronetcy title of address.

name: Dame
description: A woman holding the female equivalent of a knighthood.

name: Lord
description: A courtesy title of address for a peer or nobleman.

name: Lady
description: A courtesy title of address for a peeress or noblewoman.

name: Don
description: A Spanish and Italian honorific prefix for a respected man or woman.

name: Comrade
description: A form of address among fellow members of a party or movement.

name: Educational & Apprentice Roles
description: Roles of learning, teaching, and apprenticeship.

name: Learner Roles
description: Roles of those acquiring knowledge, skill, or training.

name: Student
description: A person enrolled in formal education.

name: Scholar
description: A person devoted to advanced study and research.

name: Apprentice
description: A person learning a trade under a master.

name: Intern
description: A student or recent graduate gaining supervised work experience.

name: Alumnus
description: A former student of a school or university.

name: Autodidact
description: A self-taught person who learns without formal instruction.

name: Instructor & Peer Roles
description: Roles of teaching and peer leadership in learning settings.

name: Teacher
description: A person who instructs students in a school or classroom.

name: Tutor
description: A person who gives individual or small-group instruction.

name: Class Monitor
description: A student who assists the teacher and leads classmates.

name: Prefect
description: A senior student with authority over younger students.

name: Classmate
description: A fellow member of the same class or cohort.

name: Economic & Exchange Social Roles
description: Roles defined by property, credit, and exchange relations.

name: Property & Tenure Roles
description: Roles defined by ownership and occupancy of property.

name: Landlord
description: A person who owns and rents out property.

name: Tenant
description: A person who occupies property under a lease.

name: Homeowner
description: A person who owns the home they live in.

name: Squatter
description: A person who occupies unowned or abandoned property without title.

name: Credit & Obligation Roles
description: Roles defined by lending, borrowing, and guaranteeing debts.

name: Creditor
description: A person to whom money is owed.

name: Debtor
description: A person who owes money.

name: Guarantor
description: A person who pledges to repay another's debt if they default.

name: Exchange & Client Roles
description: Roles in buying, selling, and client relationships.

name: Customer
description: A person who buys goods or services.

name: Client
description: A person who receives professional services.

name: Vendor
description: A person who sells goods or services.

name: Martial & Defense Social Roles
description: Civic and status roles tied to armed service and martial standing.

name: Veteran
description: A person who has served in the armed forces.

name: Reservist
description: A civilian who trains part-time as a military reserve member.

name: Conscript
description: A person drafted into compulsory military service.

name: Warrior
description: A person whose social role is fighting, often with a code of honor.

name: Samurai
description: A hereditary warrior-aristocrat of feudal Japan.

name: Rōnin
description: A masterless samurai in feudal Japan.

name: Ghazi
description: A Muslim warrior who fought in frontier campaigns, a revered status in some traditions.
